title: 15.63. Kāmāvacaraduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Kāmāvacaraṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanakāmāvacaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nakāmāvacaraṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanakāmāvacaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
Kāmāvacaraṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanakāmāvacaro naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ. (Abyākatamūlaṁ dve paccayavasena.)
